You: I was angry of course! Once again I have someone talking behind my back! 
You: Couldn’t you just call me instead? 
Blaubleim: W-well, psychologists and psychiatrists sometimes call parents of their patients. It’s an absolutely normal thing. 
Blaubleim: As I said before, it’s hard to ask for help and sometimes patients omit important things to make themselves seem healthier than they really are.
You: …
Blaubleim: Just…{{wi}} try to calm down and think about it with a cool head, ok?
You: …{{wi}} ok.
